summary.intent: Get the monokl 0.8.0 changelog entries rewritten to be short and user-first (via a subagent), then upgrade Callisto from 0.20 to 0.22 to use its simplified TOML config.
summary.outcome: A subagent produced PR #122 (rewritten changesets, CONTRIBUTING rules, and a changeset-lint script wired into just and CI), with CI pending and the diff not yet reviewed. A second agent was launched to prepare the Callisto 0.22 upgrade on a separate branch, with no result yet.

repo: Changesets for 0.8.0 follow a fixed shape: lead-in, at most 4 bullets, short Breaking and Action paragraphs, one headline number each, and library-API notes as one marked sentence at the end.
Detailed numbers and rejected options live in decision-log sections 51 and 52, not in changesets.
Callisto version pins appear in several places that must be bumped together: .prototools, workflow action commits and version inputs, and scripts/check-drift.sh.
The release workflow has local deviations from the generated one (ref: github.sha checkouts, zizmor comments, verification: require) that need re-justifying against the 0.22 output.
Release PR #119 regenerates from changesets, so #122 must merge before #119 is read or merged; #121 (docs) is independent and waits only on green CI.
just verify-release <version> is used to verify a published release.
Verification commands used: just changesets, just typos, scripts/check-drift.sh.

code.finding: New lint that rejects 'harness', decision-log section numbers, script names, grids, doc paths, and more than 4 bullets in changesets; has a test and runs via just changesets and the CI Changesets job.

workflow: The `callisto release --dry-run` command only reports 'Nothing to release', so rendering the changelog requires `callisto version` in a scratch copy.
Running `callisto version` stages files in the worktree index, so they need to be unstaged and the scratch copy removed afterward.
Subagent reports are unreviewed claims. The assistant noted it had not read the diff and planned to check the rendered 0.8.0 section in the release PR itself.
Encoding a writing rule as an automated check keeps it enforced without anyone having to remember it.

friction: callisto release --dry-run gives no rendered preview, forcing a scratch-copy workaround.
callisto version staged three files into the agent's worktree index, which needed manual cleanup.
The real publish, attestation, and new job split in Callisto 0.22 cannot be rehearsed before an actual release.
open_items: Merge #122 once CI is green, then confirm #119 regenerates with the rewritten 0.8.0 text.
Merge #119, publish 0.8.0 on the current proven workflow, and run just verify-release 0.8.0.
Review the Callisto 0.22 upgrade PR and merge it only after 0.8.0 is published; treat the next release as its proof.
Decide whether to adopt callisto status --check --since origin/main, only if it removes code or covers a missed case.
Merge docs PR #121 when CI is green.
Review the actual diff of #122, which has not been read yet.
